Definition: properly, to whisper a spell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for whispering spells and practising sorcery, the craft God flatly forbade His people and said must not live among them. Pharaoh's magicians used it, Manasseh used it in the valley of Hinnom, and God names sorcerers among those He will judge. It is never treated as a curiosity or a harmless skill, but as a rival trust set against the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God bans sorcery because it seeks power apart from Him, and I hold that any path to hidden knowledge that goes around the Lord is a snare, not a shortcut. My position is plain: the God who speaks is enough, and I will not trade His voice for a whisper.
